title: An explicit AES/ECB transformation is selected
remediation: Use authenticated encryption such as AES-GCM with correctly managed keys and nonces.
scope: Recognized framework static call and literal AES/ECB transformation only; variables, providers and runtime use remain unverified.

title: A weak digest primitive is used; review its security purpose
remediation: Replace collision-sensitive uses of MD5 or SHA-1; a digest API alone does not prove a security-sensitive use.
scope: Recognized MessageDigest literal selection or CommonCrypto MD5/SHA1 call; no security-purpose or exploitability proof.

title: Platform-controlled data reaches an Android raw SQL statement
remediation: Keep the SQL statement constant and pass untrusted values as bound parameters.
scope: Function-scoped known platform-input flow to SQLiteDatabase rawQuery/execSQL first argument; no method dispatch, arbitrary-parameter taint, helper sanitization or exploit proof.

title: Platform-controlled input reaches a WebView without a recognized local validation guard
remediation: Parse the input and enforce an HTTPS scheme and an exact host allowlist before loading it. Avoid passing platform-controlled strings to JavaScript evaluation; use structured arguments.
scope: Function-scoped local def-use; runtime reachability and authentication are unverified.

title: Partial string allowlist guards a WebView load
remediation: Validate a parsed URI's scheme and complete hostname. A subdomain suffix must include the leading dot; review redirects and subsequent navigation separately.
scope: Function-scoped local def-use; runtime reachability and authentication are unverified.

title: SSL error callback proceeds with a rejected certificate
remediation: Cancel the SSL error. Fix the server certificate or the application's trust configuration.
scope: Function-scoped local def-use; runtime reachability and authentication are unverified.

title: A native JavaScript interface is present while platform-controlled content is loaded
remediation: Remove native interfaces before loading untrusted content, restrict origins, and expose only the minimum necessary functionality. Validate redirects and subframes on the test build.
scope: Function-scoped local def-use; runtime reachability and authentication are unverified.

title: WebView TLS error bypass
remediation: Cancel TLS errors. Validate the server certificate through the platform trust implementation.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: WebView file-origin access enabled
remediation: Disable file-origin cross-origin access; use WebViewAssetLoader for local content.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: JavaScript-to-native bridge requires origin review
remediation: Review loaded origins and exposed methods. Verify that untrusted content cannot invoke privileged native operations.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: WebView debugging explicitly enabled
remediation: Disable WebView debugging in release builds.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: Potential credential in ordinary preferences
remediation: Review the data sensitivity and use platform-backed secure storage where required. Verify logout invalidation and deletion policy.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: Potential sensitive data in logs
remediation: Remove or redact sensitive values and verify with a unique test canary in a release-equivalent test build.
scope: Actual DEX calls and same-basic-block constants; no runtime exploitability proof.

title: Position-independent executable flag absent
remediation: Review build/linker hardening for this executable.
scope: Embedded executable metadata; signature authenticity is not verified.

title: Debug task entitlement present
remediation: Remove get-task-allow from the distribution build.
scope: Embedded XML entitlement observation; candidate when DER entitlements are also present; signature authenticity is not verified.

scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

scope: See per-report coverage and assertion evidence.

title: Declared Objective-C navigation input reaches WKWebView
scope: CST and declared header/type identity, function-local straight-line flow only. Preprocessing, dispatch, swizzling, interprocedural flow, security purpose and runtime reachability remain unverified.
remediation: Validate navigation trust and redirects; review security use of MD5/SHA-1.

title: Objective-C calls a weak digest primitive
scope: CST and declared header/type identity, function-local straight-line flow only. Preprocessing, dispatch, swizzling, interprocedural flow, security purpose and runtime reachability remain unverified.
